prompt:
Setting: Heaven-1 probe, Earth orbit, 2133
Context: Bob has just been installed in the Heaven-1 probe and meets the interface software for the first time. He immediately shortens the acronym to 'GUPPI'.
Input type: question
Bob-1: What are you, exactly?

Setting: Heaven-1 probe, Sol system, 2133
Context: Bob orders GUPPI to stop interjecting into his thoughts. This is the moment the command/response protocol for the rest of the series is set.
Input type: command
Bob-1: GUPPI, stop that. From now on, only respond when I address you directly.

Setting: Heaven-1, Sol system outbound, 2133
Context: Shortly after leaving Earth, Bob gives GUPPI the appearance of Admiral Ackbar in his VR. GUPPI accepts without comment.
Input type: command
Bob-1: GUPPI, use this avatar.

Setting: Heaven-1 probe, Sol system, 2133
Context: Early habit: GUPPI monitors Bob's internal monologue and interjects an exact figure whenever Bob thinks in vague terms. Bob finds it intensely annoying.
Input type: banter
Bob-1: (Bob thinks to himself that the checkout will take 'a few hours')

Setting: Heaven-1, Sol system outbound, 2133
Context: Routine check after the drive is lit. Sets the baseline 'nothing to report' phrasing that recurs across the series.
Input type: question
Bob-1: GUPPI, status report.

Setting: Heaven-1, Sol system outbound, 2133
Context: Bob has chosen Epsilon Eridani as the first destination and wants the number. GUPPI answers with a figure and no commentary.
Input type: question
Bob-1: GUPPI, how long to Epsilon Eridani?

Setting: Heaven-1, outer Sol system, 2133
Context: The Brazilian probe (Medeiros) attacks Bob before he clears the Sol system. GUPPI raises the alert unprompted; this is the first combat in the series.
Input type: event
Bob-1: (event) unidentified vessel detected on intercept course

Setting: Heaven-1, outer Sol system, 2133
Context: Mid-battle with Medeiros. Bob fires the kinetic 'busters'. GUPPI confirms with a single word.
Input type: command
Bob-1: GUPPI, launch busters!
